proposals.title: Define the observation operator before enforcing biological conservation
proposals.claim: A capture/panel/normalization/frame contract will distinguish numerical mass normalization from a testable cell-growth or tissue conservation claim.
proposals.mechanism: PROCESS checks for mmd_u, scale_log_ratio and neighborhood_mmd: expose capture/abundance nonidentifiability and document preprocessing/units; abstain on latent cause without calibrated auxiliary measurements. No score gain asserted.
proposals.falsifier: Reject the contract if it assigns different abundance/capture causes to observationally equivalent synthetic worlds without auxiliary evidence, or fails declared unit checks. Synthetic checks establish measurement behavior only.

evidence.says: Validator checks file shape, gene order, finite nonnegative expression and finite coordinates, not capture or physical conservation.
Independent snapshots lose temporal coupling; OT adds transition assumptions and modifies mass constraints for proliferation and death.

proposals.title: Require matched randomized-prior controls before attributing benefit to biology
proposals.claim: A real graph prior must outperform matched-capacity no-prior and randomized-prior controls preserving degree and, where feasible, evidence density, state specificity and expression support before biological-information attribution.
proposals.mechanism: PROCESS validation of mmd_u and de_direction: freeze training-only graph construction and equal tuning budgets; compare independent-stage/embryo effects rather than solver convergence or training reconstruction.
proposals.falsifier: Reject biological-information attribution if the real prior fails the prespecified practical margin over randomized priors or the gain disappears with training-only preprocessing.

evidence.says: Requests no, known, learned and randomized-prior comparisons; randomized benefit can indicate regularization rather than biological knowledge.
SciML remit includes mechanistic constraints, scientific priors, conservation laws and model identifiability.

peer_responses.on: Capture versus abundance ambiguity and richer randomized-prior controls
peer_responses.because: Accept: c_s*N_s products can match across distinct latent worlds. agent_orchestrator.py:128-147 validates shape, not capture. Require abstention; preserve evidence density/state specificity/support where feasible and disclose unmatched channels.

self_correction: Initial r1-1 mechanism/falsifier overstated capture identifiability. Documentation exposes ambiguity; observationally equivalent worlds require abstention absent calibrated auxiliary measurements. Graph nulls now match additional evidence channels where feasible.
declined: Hard mass conservation and universal latent/spatial smoothness: recovered row counts do not establish cell-number conservation, and developing tissues can contain sharp boundaries.
